shellCommands.command: ls; cat package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; ls src 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -B2 -A8 "chart" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,120p

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx AGENTS.md; ls __agent_eval__; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/.package-lock.json >/dev/null && echo ok; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head
npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -15; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -A12 '"peerDependencies"'

for v in 1 1.0; do :; done; npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json 2>&1 | tr -d '\n ' | grep -o '"1\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*"' | tail -5; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | tail -25

npm install @gravity-ui/charts@^1.73.0 2>&1 | tail -8; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs 2>&1 | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs && cat INDEX.md | head -60; grep -rn -i "theme\|dark" get-started.md | head -20; ls guides
cat guides/theming.md; sed -n 20,70p get-started.md; ls guides/series-types; sed -n 1,80p guides/series-types/line.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -rn "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; cat tsconfig.json
git status --short; rm -rf dist; git check-ignore dist node_modules
